components.name: VoiceAssistantCard
components.description: Real-time voice assistant with orb visualizer, streaming ASR/LLM/TTS, and barge-in support

wsUrl.title: Orchestrator URL
wsUrl.description: Python orchestrator HTTP/WS base URL (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:9384)

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: Acoustic + backend profile. Switching triggers a ~1-3s reload on the server.

neoMindToken.title: NeoMind API Token
neoMindToken.description: Required for the default profile (NeoMind cloud LLM). Stored only in the Python orchestrator process memory.

language.title: ASR Language
language.description: Speech recognition language hint. 'auto' detects automatically.

voice.title: TTS Voice
voice.description: Voice ID passed to TTS backend (e.g. '中文女' for ZipVoice)

directMode.title: Direct Python WS Mode
directMode.description: Debug only. Bypass the NeoMind stream endpoint and connect directly to the Python orchestrator WS. Disables capability-path LLM.
